reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

methods.source_location: Qin et al. (2023), Materials and methods, page 2332: Pt foil for pressure calibration (Fei et al. 2007)
methods.notes: The citation identifies the internally consistent Fei et al. Pt scale, but that Pt scale is not presently an executable shared-library record.

recalculation.notes: Tables S3-S4 retain only reduced sample pressures; row-wise platinum lattice parameters or volumes are not published, so observation-level pressure recalculation is impossible.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the final article and official MSA deposit AM-23-128432. The published BM3 coefficients reproduce the complete printed compression table to 0.3887 GPa pressure RMSE; the missing row-wise pressure uncertainties and exact EosFit7c weight configuration prevent coefficient-level refit parity and are not inferred.

locations: official Online Materials Tables S4 and S5
primary_source_check.finding: The source fully defines a room-temperature, three-free-parameter standard Eulerian BM3 fit for the Fe-bearing Na0.88Al0.99Fe0.13Si0.94O4 sample. Volumes are Pbnm conventional-cell values with Z=4. The official deposit does not include an exact Fe-bearing positional refinement, so the material's structural proxy is explicitly qualified.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from the abstract, page 2333 and Online Materials Table S5 (this-study Fe-bearing column), fitted to the 10 rows of Table S4. The superscript a on the 1.7 GPa row of Table S4 is not defined in the source.

primary_data_check.finding: All 10 printed pressure, lattice-parameter, conventional-cell-volume, and parenthetical uncertainty rows are bundled verbatim. No pressure uncertainty or row-wise temperature is published.

numerical_reproduction.tolerance_basis: The largest absolute pressure residual over all 10 Table S4 rows under the rounded published coefficients is 0.7907 GPa.

refit_reproduction.finding: The article reports error-weighted EosFit7c regression but publishes no pressure uncertainties, covariance matrix, or detailed weight settings. Both documented diagnostic refits use all rows and remain separate from the published record.

reported_inconsistencies.finding: No definition for this superscript is printed in the Online Materials; the marker is retained as source_note_a without interpretation.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: article Materials and methods, pages 2332-2333; article EOS discussion, page 2333; official Online Materials Tables S4 and S5; official deposit AM-23-128432.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article pages 2332-2333 and official Online Materials Table S5: third-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS fitted with EosFit7c
parameter_provenance.V0: Article abstract and page 2333; Online Materials Table S5, this-study Fe-bearing column: 244.2(2) A^3 fitted Pbnm conventional-cell volume
parameter_provenance.K0: Article abstract and page 2333; Online Materials Table S5, this-study Fe-bearing column: KT0=211(6) GPa
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Article abstract and page 2333; Online Materials Table S5, this-study Fe-bearing column: K'T0=2.6(3)
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Article states room-temperature compression; official companion CIF measurement reports 293(2) K
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Online Materials Tables S4 and S5 report 10 observations spanning 0-44.0 GPa; no exclusions are stated

superseded_record_text.notes: Standard third-order Birch-Murnaghan pressure-volume EOS in the Eulerian finite-strain convention at room temperature. V0, K0, and K0_prime were all fitted with EosFit7c; none was fixed. Parenthesized coefficient errors are retained as generic published uncertainties because the source gives neither confidence level nor covariance. The observed range is not a phase-stability guarantee. See docs/qin-2023-naalsio4-eos.md.
validity_notes: The pressure and volume-ratio bounds are the Table S4 observation envelope, not a broader phase-stability guarantee.
All measurements are described as room temperature; 293 K is the explicit temperature of the companion official CIF measurement, and no row-wise temperatures are published.
